root_cause_found: BEC-PRIME/package.json had no start script while render.yaml required npm start. The canonical start.js runtime also relied on authRuntimePreload to mount routes/auth.js, but that preload was not invoked by the Render start command.
changes: Added npm start script: node -r ./lib/authRuntimePreload.js start.js
Activated canonical /api/account/* auth handler through the existing runtime preload
Kept persistent user storage under DREAMIEZ_DATA_DIR or /var/data/dreamiez
remaining_gate: Production deployment must consume commit 912c1b80ede621abde7776333a62973a1330795f. Live registration/login must then be probed.
